disease_label_per_paper: Anti-GBM antibody disease (seropositive, without linear IgG deposition) with rapidly progressive crescentic glomerulonephritis and diffuse non-hereditary GBM thinning of uncertain etiology in a 70-year-old woman
presentation_summary: 70-year-old woman with well-controlled hypertension developed fever (max 38.7 C) with pharyngeal discomfort, cough, low back pain (lumbago) and dysuria on 2025-07-25.
At the first visit on 2025-07-30 (day -6): WBC 10.53 x10^9/L, CRP 218.4 mg/L; chest CT read as bronchial disease with scattered chronic infectious foci; treated with antibiotics without improvement.
On 2025-08-05 (day 0): urine protein (+), urine RBC 2,424/uL, serum creatinine 293 umol/L (eGFR 14 mL/min/1.73 m2), 24-h urine protein 0.321 g.
time_zero_definition: Day 0 = 2025-08-05, the renal laboratory evaluation that revealed the elevated creatinine (the paper's chief complaint is elevated serum creatinine discovered >20 days before admission), after antibiotics and before any immunosuppression. First medical visit 2025-07-30 = day -6; fever onset 2025-07-25 = day -11. The paper's formal admission on 2025-08-30 was after steroid pulse, plasma exchange and dialysis and is not used as presentation.

confirmatory_findings.finding: Renal biopsy: cellular crescents in 5 of 7 viable glomeruli, capillary loop collapse, focal fibrinoid necrosis; IF pauci-immune without linear IgG (all IgG subclasses negative); EM diffuse GBM thinning (~80% of loops <250 nm); COL4A3/4/5 no pathogenic variants
confirmatory_findings.source_text_value: four cellular crescents and one small focal cellular crescent ... Immunofluorescence: IgG (–), IgA (–), IgM (±), C3 (+, non-specific) ... diffuse thinning of the glomerular basement membrane ... No pathogenic or likely pathogenic variants related to TBMN were detected

ANCA-associated glomerulonephritis is characterized by positive ANCA, which was negative in this case; lupus nephritis usually presents with positive autoimmune antibodies and full-house immunofluorescence, which was also excluded

confirmatory_findings.finding: Chest CT at first visit read as bronchial disease with scattered chronic infectious foci (non-specific, not structured)
confirmatory_findings.source_text_value: Chest CT suggested bronchial disease and scattered chronic infectious foci in the lungs.

confirmatory_findings.finding: Post-treatment course: creatinine 500 umol/L with persistent anuria on 2025-08-10; admission 2025-08-30 after steroids/plasma exchange/dialysis: T 36.5 C, BP 145/85, facial and leg pitting edema, Hb 71 g/L, neutrophils 95.1%, creatinine 438.2 umol/L, hypoxemia, chest CT without pulmonary hemorrhage
confirmatory_findings.source_text_value: 2025-08-10 Serum creatinine increased to 500 μmol/L; persistent anuria ... Physical examination on admission: temperature 36.5 °C, blood pressure 145/85 mmHg ... hemoglobin 71 g/L, neutrophil percentage 95.1%, serum creatinine 438.2 μmol/L, anti-GBM antibody 158 AU/mL, accompanied by hypoxemia ... Chest CT showed no evidence of pulmonary hemorrhage

Anti-GBM antibody disease, rapidly progressive crescentic glomerulonephritis, diffuse non-hereditary glomerular basement membrane thinning of uncertain etiology, chronic kidney disease stage 5, renal anemia.

actual_treatment: methylprednisolone 500 mg/day x3, then prednisone 60 mg/day
plasma exchange x14, later double filtration plasmapheresis

outcome.source_text_value: She remained on regular hemodialysis with stable overall condition.

quality_warnings: Presentation reconstructed from the pre-treatment timeline (2025-07-25 to 2025-08-05); the paper's formal admission (2025-08-30) is post-treatment and non-ranking.
No heart rate, respiratory rate, blood pressure or hemoglobin were reported before treatment.
Initial chest CT description is interpretive and non-specific; kept record-only.
Anti-GBM serology, renal biopsy, EM, genetic testing and ANCA status are confirmatory and non-ranking.
